# Unit test for function digits
def test_digits():
    # All odd digits -> product of them
    assert digits(5) == 5
    assert digits(135) == 15        # 1*3*5
    assert digits(111) == 1
    assert digits(999) == 729

    # Mixed digits -> product of odd digits only
    assert digits(1234) == 3        # only 1 and 3 are odd
    assert digits(2468) == 0        # no odd digits
    assert digits(305) == 15        # 3*5 (0 is skipped, even)

    # Edge cases
    assert digits(0) == 0           # 0 is even -> no odd digits
    assert digits(1) == 1           # smallest odd input
    assert digits(100) == 1         # single odd digit among evens

    print("All tests passed.")

test_digits()
```
